rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Bray provides 235 tools across 27 groups for interacting with the Nostr protocol, enabling AI agents to manage identities, social feeds, encrypted messaging, zaps (Lightning payments), trust graphs, and cryptographic access control. It integrates with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other MCP-compatible clients, offering a comprehensive interface to the decentralized Nostr network. The server is part of the ForgeSworn open-source toolkit for sovereign identity and commerce.
